meta.name: Tiny BPE LM
meta.description: Subword (BPE) next-token prediction over the built-in corpus: 64 tokens of context from a ~320-token vocabulary learned by merging the most frequent character pairs. Common words collapse to one or two tokens, so each context window carries far more text than the character-level dataset — and there is no <unk> for words, only for unseen characters.
meta.attribution: Built-in corpus tokenised with BPE (285 learned merges, 320 tokens, 64-token context). The merge rules are saved with exported models, so the exported runtime tokenises exactly as this app does.
